script.text:
"""Old-boundary palette diagnosis, no identity threshold selected."""
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import cv2,numpy as np
from app.tracking.teams import torso_color,chromaticity

def sha(p):
    with Path(p).open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
prior=Path('.cache/consensus-boundary-features-v1/report.json')
data=json.loads(prior.read_text());out=Path('.cache/boundary-palette-diagnostic-v1');out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
paths=[Path(__file__),prior,Path('app/tracking/teams.py')]+[Path(r['case'][k]) for r in data['reports'] for k in ['video','predictions']]
hashes={str(p):sha(p) for p in paths};results=[]
cv2.setNumThreads(1)
for r in data['reports']:
    c=r['case'];p=json.loads(Path(c['predictions']).read_text());centers=np.array(p['summary']['team_colors'])
    cap=cv2.VideoCapture(c['video']);rows=[]
    for row in r['rows']:
        cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES,row['frame_idx']);ok,bgr=cap.read();assert ok
        color=torso_color(cv2.cvtColor(bgr,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB),row['box'])
        assert color is not None
        rows.append(dict(order=row['order'],side=row['side'],rgb=color.tolist(),
            nearest_rgb=int(np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(centers-color,axis=1))),
            nearest_tint=int(np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(chromaticity(centers)-chromaticity(color),axis=1)))))
    cap.release();windows={}
    for n in [3,5,8,12]:
        a=[x for x in rows if x['side']=='before'][-n:];b=[x for x in rows if x['side']=='after'][:n]
        stats=[]
        for arr in [a,b]:
            color=np.median([x['rgb'] for x in arr],axis=0)
            stats.append(dict(count=len(arr),median_rgb=color.tolist(),
                rgb_distances=np.linalg.norm(centers-color,axis=1).tolist(),
                tint_distances=np.linalg.norm(chromaticity(centers)-chromaticity(color),axis=1).tolist(),
                nearest_rgb=int(np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(centers-color,axis=1))),
                nearest_tint=int(np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(chromaticity(centers)-chromaticity(color),axis=1)))))
        windows[str(n)]=dict(before=stats[0],after=stats[1])
    results.append(dict(case=c,centers=centers.tolist(),rows=rows,windows=windows))
    print(c['segment'],c['raw_id'],{k: [(x['nearest_rgb'],x['nearest_tint']) for x in v.values()] for k,v in windows.items()},flush=True)
assert hashes=={p:sha(p) for p in hashes}
(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(hashes=hashes,results=results,limits='Seven old boundaries only. Global team palette is not person ground truth. No candidate selected.'),indent=2))
